# n8n_credential (Data Source)

Fetches a single n8n credential by ID or name. Uses the list endpoint with client-side filtering.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Credential identifier. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Credential name. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the credential was created
- `type` (String) Credential type (e.g., httpHeaderAuth)
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the credential was last updated
